# Sketch format provenance

Open Workflow Kit does not vendor Sketch source code or the upstream schema bundle.

The zero-dependency writer emits the documented ZIP/JSON container shape needed by this feature's constrained fixture and records `sketch_schema_version` in each report. Real Sketch client open/edit/save/reopen evidence remains mandatory before the target capability can move from `NOT_VERIFIED` to `SUPPORTED`.

Reference documentation: `https://developer.sketch.com/file-format/` (last product review: 2026-07-28). The URL is documentation provenance, not a claim of official certification.
